data.title: Build a Product Landing Page
data.outcome: Use one clear reading path to explain the product's value, build trust, and guide visitors to act.
intentExamples: Build a website for my product
Introduce my product and get users to sign up

stages.title: State the problem your product solves
stages.action: Write one specific promise and provide one primary call to action.
stages.evidence: From the first screen, visitors can name the product's audience, value, and next step.

lessons.title: Hero
lessons.tagline: Use the opening area to explain the page's main point and next step

lessons.title: CTA
lessons.tagline: Tell visitors the next action you want them to take

stages.title: Show what the product can do
stages.action: Add real product screens or representative use cases.
stages.evidence: The proof directly supports the promise on the first screen instead of serving as decoration.

lessons.title: Image
lessons.tagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

lessons.title: Video
lessons.tagline: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page

lessons.title: Card
lessons.tagline: Keep information about one item in a single block

stages.title: Provide proof where visitors need trust
stages.action: Place customers, case studies, or verifiable data near important claims.
stages.evidence: Each piece of proof addresses a real concern.

lessons.title: Social Proof
lessons.tagline: Support a product claim with evidence from real use

lessons.title: Customer Testimonial
lessons.tagline: Use real customer words to show a concrete experience

lessons.title: Statistic
lessons.tagline: Highlight a small number of important values

stages.title: Answer pricing questions and common concerns
stages.action: Explain plan differences, limits, and frequently asked questions.
stages.evidence: Visitors can decide whether it fits without hunting around the page.

lessons.title: Pricing
lessons.tagline: Help visitors compare plans, cost, and included value

lessons.title: FAQ
lessons.tagline: Answer common questions before visitors need to ask

stages.title: Lead naturally from reading to action
stages.action: Check the section order, in-page navigation, and final call to action.
stages.evidence: There is one clear main path from the first screen to the end.

lessons.title: Single Page
lessons.tagline: Arrange a complete story in sections down one scrolling page

lessons.title: Footer
lessons.tagline: End the page with useful links, identity, and required information

lessons.title: Anchor
lessons.tagline: Jump to a named section on the same long page
